‘Market Mulled Wine’ technical file

Name                                         Market Mulled Wine
Name and address of applicant                Mulled Wine Guild
                                             1 Market Square
                                             Oldtown
                                             Producers:
                                             Old Cellar Ltd, Oldtown
                                             Spice House Ltd, Oldtown
                                             Winter Wines Ltd, Oldtown

Description of principal analytical and      Colour: ruby red, clear.
organoleptic characteristics                 Smell and taste: cinnamon and cloves on a
                                             sweet red-wine base.
                                             Actual alcoholic strength: at least 8.5 % vol.
Specific production processes and            Red wine is sweetened, spiced and heated; no
specifications                               water is added.
Demarcation of the relevant geographical     City of Oldtown
area                                         Production takes place within the city.
Link pursuant to Article 2(3) of            The link to the area relates to the special
Regulation (EU) No 251/2014                  reputation.
                                             The drink has been served at the Christmas
                                             market of Oldtown since around 1970.
                                             Its recipe is kept by the guild.
Names and addresses of the authorities       Food Inspectorate, Oldtown
